preconditions.description: The charging duration a and shooting duration b must be between 1 and 1000 seconds.
The coordinates of points A and B must be within the range of -10,000 to 10,000 meters.
The number of trenches n must be between 1 and 1000.
The coordinates of the ends of each trench must be within the range of -10,000 to 10,000 meters.

preconditions.expression: all(abs(x1 - x2) <= b or abs(y1 - y2) <= b for x1, y1, x2, y2 in trenches)
preconditions.description: The length of any trench must not exceed b meters.

postconditions.expression: stdout == '-1' if not can_reach else True
postconditions.description: If Vasya cannot reach point B, the output must be -1.

postconditions.expression: abs(float(stdout) - min_time) < 1e-4 if can_reach else True
postconditions.description: If Vasya can reach point B, the output must be the minimum time required, with an error tolerance of 1e-4.
